game_concept: A action defense set in Shadow Cave – Shadow Pit, a pit of deep shadow: the torchbearer must handle glow-eyed lurkers while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Stamina Climb: Keep climbing while stamina > 0, deciding when to rest inside the loop.
theme: Shadow Cave – Shadow Pit: a pit of deep shadow
core_gameplay_loop: In Shadow Pit, repeat each round: Keep climbing while stamina > 0, deciding when to rest inside the loop. Each round, glow-eyed lurkers strike the ore lift, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the stamina value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the ore lift from glow-eyed lurkers in Shadow Pit: keep the stamina meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 50-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: stamina drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 50-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 3 (intro tier): Stamina Climb
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how stamina changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against glow-eyed lurkers in Shadow Pit.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 50 seconds while stamina > 0.
